fusions.name: Mildew Bloom
fusions.desc: Bursts a spore-laden pad, dealing 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Spore Wad
fusions.desc: Flings a wad of spore-packed batting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Diseased] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mossy Quilt
fusions.desc: Spreads a mildewed quilt at your feet for 8 seconds; it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Creeping Patch
fusions.desc: A patch of living mildew sewn onto your sleeve fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds within 4.5 tiles. Each strike leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
